creator: China Agricultural University
citation: China Agricultural University (2024). Field_road_dataset [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10561232
underlying_source_as_stated_by_dataset_a: Wu, C., Li, D., Zhang, X., Pan, J., Quan, L., Yang, W., Ma, Q., Su, C., Zhai, W. (2023). China's agricultural machinery operation big data system. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture, 205, 107594.
machine: tractor (make, model and implement not stated in the dataset)
accelerometer: NONE. The dataset has no accelerometer; 'accel' is empty. Nothing was synthesised.
accuracy_m: not reported by the dataset -> null
speed_mps: null: the dataset's speed column has an unexplained scale (about 1.84 x the position-derived speed), so it was not copied; derive speed from positions
timestamps: dataset local time assumed UTC+8, converted to epoch ms
field_boundary: none in the dataset (no surveyed field boundary)
reference_labels: per-fix field/road labels published with the dataset (manual annotation), stored as reference_labels intervals; they are NOT WORKING/TRANSIT/IDLE labels
changes_made: cut to one stretch of one trajectory; duplicate timestamps dropped; columns renamed; speed and accuracy set to null (see above)
app_compatibility_note: app/js/realtrack.js (trackToReplay) currently rejects recordings with fewer than 100 accel samples; this file has 0 by design, so the replay needs a GPS-only path (owner of app/ to decide). Accuracy is null: the app maps null to 99 m and its hull/coverage code drops fixes worse than 20 m.
